columns.name: USER_HISTORY_ID
columns.description: Mandatory primary key updatable while new key generation

columns.name: BUSINESS_GROUP_ID
columns.description: Identifier of Enterprise, used for multi-tenancy partitioning. Foreign key to HR_ORGANIZATION_UNITS.

columns.name: USERNAME
columns.description: The latest username of the user active between the start and end dates.

columns.name: USER_GUID
columns.description: The userGuid of the user active between the start and end dates.

columns.name: START_DATE
columns.description: The date that the user Guid/username combination is active from.

columns.name: END_DATE
columns.description: The date that the user Guid/username combination is active to.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: PERSON_ID
columns.description: The latest person_id of the user active between the start and end dates.

columns.name: PARTY_ID
columns.description: The latest party_id of the user active between the start and end dates.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_COMPONENT
columns.description: The Component that last modified the user history record.
